reactions.description: The preferred order of events in monensin biosynthesis is hydroxylation at C-26 catalysed by MonD, followed by O-methylation at the hydroxy group at C-3 catalysed by MonE
MonD catalyzes hydroxylation at C-26 of dehydroxydemethylmonensin to produce intermediate demethylmonensin
